scope: Nine pending original Forge default-suite records, followed by a fresh complete default-suite run.
production_change: MultiblockRecipePack rejects unavailable concrete original ingredients before generic fallback; only four known external stones may omit their 16 unavailable utility rows.
findings: MachineRecipeIngredients substitutions are global across packs. They were caused by missing concrete external stone inputs of OriginalSurvivalRecipes, not a basic-machine recipe gap.

Loader_MultiTileEntities:306-309,353-356,400-403,447-450 uses OP.stone.dat(aMat) and hides those items when corresponding external mods are absent. Original CR.shaped:371-405 preserves an unavailable ore-dictionary ingredient instead of substituting iron; the recipe cannot match. Modern adaptation omits the 16 unavailable rows. This is not a claim that the original CR directly skips missing ore entries.

MultiblockRecipePack now validates all concrete original survival/utility inputs before generic ingredient resolution. Only four explicit unavailable external-stone IDs can omit a row; any other absent concrete input throws. No new stone identities/material fallback are invented.
BasicMachineCraftingTests retains strict empty substitutions and checks all 16 conditional row-presence mappings plus real minecraft:stone in the four native utility recipes.

Original Loader_MultiTileEntities:2046-2078 explicitly uses DEF_REV_NCC_MIR for colored and wood decorative panels. MultiItemRandomTools:395/398 explicitly uses DEF_NCC_MIR for both early fire starters. Loader_Recipes_Woods:270 explicitly uses DEF_NCC_MIR for Blue Spruce slab.

HandCraftingTests now pins the complete source opt-in set: 78 canonical panel recipes plus fire_starter, fire_starter_2 and slab_bluespruce. Runtime VanillaCraftingRecipePack contributes 11 gt6ce-namespace wood saw rows, each required to have width 1, so reflecting them does not change the pattern. No unexpected mirror flag is allowed; missing opt-ins fail too.

Creative mocks are correctly radiation-immune. Exposure tests use real survival mocks; all 24/25/50/75/100+ symptoms, overflow, NBT and clone checks remain. Radaway uses native item use/player ticks and Forge Finish dispatch; doses 100->50->0 and counts 2->1->empty are checked at full hunger.

SurfaceFlora uses string biome keys. Dungeon wet ceilings use fixed brown glow-glass identity for source theme 3. Portal slot22 is the green-cover hunting manual, checked for count, identity and complete contents.

The mob-platform proxy permits only writes and WATER/5-tick scheduling, verifies local chunk ownership, existing water sources and exactly16 unique schedules; complete maps and scheduling sets must match in forward and reverse chunk order.

Queen-death tests follow original :137: an empty main drone slot is skipped; an incompatible item remains; compatible parked drones merge only exact matching children. Three natural breeding cycles check every offspring identity/genome/count exactly once, first highest-aggression princess promotion, pending brood clearing, and old corpse clearing with exact queen-corpse NBT. Parents have different lifespan/aggression genomes to distinguish the corpses.
